notes.title: Rinlo Releases its final Full game
notes.content:
Rinlo just released its final two chapters, completing the adventure. The full game will be available on both SteamVR, and Viveport, including with infinity subscription. The full game will also shortly be released to the Oculus store.

Check out the final full trailer and Raindance festival nomination announcement:
[previewyoutube=ZFjx_1HNIKE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

You will now be able to complete the climax of the story, and discover Agatha and Rinlo's true fate. Continuing in the quest against the game's enemies, The Citizen's, Agatha and her father will battle on in the hopes of saving Rinlo. Also, you will be able to continue to participate in the increasingly more challenging puzzles, as well as exploring the final tantalising locations of the story.

It is also possible to make the most of Rinlo's haptic integration through the use of the bHaptic suit within these exciting final chapters, as well as pushing the boundaries of the immersive nature of their headsets when exploring each new area. Also, the game now features full Windows Mixed Reality Support!

Rinlo's release comes just before the start of this years Raindance Immersive festival begins on October 28th, in which it is nominated for the Discovery Award: Best Debut. The game can be found as part of the official selection on Viveport. The category winners will be announced during a virtual awards ceremony on November 7th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559070/3fa54dcaf04d983c9cfe2622016aa6c29278ceba.jpg[/img]

As mentioned, Rinlo will be available on Viveport and Steam VR, with presence on the Oculus store to follow shortly after. Rinlo can be played with HTC Vive and Vive Cosmos, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index and WMR devices.

Finally, we would like to thank everyone for all of their support so far, and we can not wait to see what Rinlo's future holds.

We hope you enjoy these final new and exciting chapters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559070/93cefd3a347faa2f9253a2b399ba481763dd2626.png[/img]

notes.title: Rinlo - Major new update with two new chapters and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559070/64e6e1ce87b5b937a424bd72ab0df05448ab7d09.png[/img]
We are excited to announce some major new updates to VR adventure game Rinlo: we are adding two new chapters to the story! Also, after receiving great feedback from you guys over the last few months, we have been able to improve the game creating an even better player experience.

So, let’s get into it!

[previewyoutube=kIeiI1XUKCc;full][/previewyoutube]


We have added two exciting new chapters to our story. Get ready to meet Agatha’s father, Edwin, a man she thought was lost forever. Alongside this we finally meet our main enemies, The Citizens, so get ready to continue to fight to survive and find the truth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559070/dae004fd63ca8b88ed8251ee6bc584d3d44c868b.jpg[/img]

A new level of complexity and variety can be found in these new chapters as the story begins to evolve. Not only will you find more challenging puzzles, you will have to use quick wit to out smart The Citizens to progress along your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559070/d04da3d67d5dddfca7a8805fd1721a9e2c341ec3.jpg[/img]

Our new update isn’t all we’ve got for you. There are also some additional updates such as improved effects, new gameplay mechanics, performance enhancements and haptic suit support, thanks to our partnership with bHaptics, that create an even more immersive game.

We hope you love our new updates as much as we do!

notes.title: Update to game with new features
notes.content:
After the successful launch of Rinlo’s Early Access version last week, we have received lots of great feedback from you all! We are committed to improving the game day after day, so we can deliver the most polished and enjoyable final version on our full release day in October.

Therefore, today we are launching a new Free Update that will add some more features to the gameplay and improve on the overall performance of the game. Here is a list of the new features:

[b]Agatha now projects a shadow on the ground.[/b]
This helps to integrate the character more into the environment.

[b]New Chapter selection in the menu.[/b]
You will now have the option to go back to a certain part of the story and keep playing from there.

[b]The option to hide the controller hands in VR is now available in the settings menu.[/b]
The hands show useful information from Agatha’s inventory, but as requested by some of Rinlo’s players we’ve implemented this option to make them less distracting during the gameplay.

[b]New character locator.[/b]
If you press the trigger without aiming it will create a light shockwave to help you find Agatha in the level.
This feature will help the players find Agatha if she is far away or outside the player’s visual field.

[b]Other improvements on this update:[/b]

- Geometry optimization for the heavier scenes of the game.

- Smaller improvements to materials and IA.

We hope you enjoy this update!

Don't forget to check us out on social media, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FW5Kkrk]Discord[/url] to get involved in our community.

notes.title: Rinlo’s Early Access available NOW
notes.content:
First of all a huge THANK YOU to everyone who joined in Rinlo's Demo and 'Behind the Scenes' live stream at last week's Steam Games Festival: Summer Edition. We are now excited to announce that the Early Access version of action-adventure Rinlo has now released on Steam. Rinlo's Early Access version will be available exclusively on Steam!

The Early Access version will allow you to immerse yourself in Rinlo's steampunk dystopia, joining Agatha as she embarks on the journey of a lifetime. You will have the opportunity to expand on any experience you gained during the Demo, as the Early Access will contain the first four chapters of the story. Continue to gain a great insight into the enthralling world of Rinlo, solving intricate puzzles, crafting distracting devices and meeting some exciting characters as you help Agatha begin to uncover the truth.

For those of you that have played the Demo, there will be an option to play the new additional levels once you have installed the new version. This Early Access version will continue to update throughout the summer with additional chapters and features being added.

The full and complete version of Rinlo will not be available until later this year. However, it will not only be released on Steam, but Viveport and the Oculus store too!

We can’t wait for you to continue on this journey with Agatha. Don’t forget to share your experiences across social media @rinlogame, or join our Discord server and become part of our community.

Happy playing!

notes.title: Creating Rinlo - Behind the Scenes Live-Stream
notes.content:
[h3][b]Follow the live-stream from our Steam Store Page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297010/Rinlo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297010/Rinlo/[/url][/b][/h3]


How was Agatha animated? How many time does it take to create a scene? Join us on a unique live-stream where you will be able to learn how the world of Rinlo was created and what it takes to create a VR game from scratch.
Join our lead developer and check out some never-before-seen behind the scenes footage of our levels and assets.

Rinlo is an exciting new adventure game developed explicitly for Virtual Reality. With the use of complex puzzles, enthralling characters and the exploration of a steampunk dystopia, you will have the opportunity to immerse yourself fully in a story like no other.

[b]Releasing June 23 on Early Access on Steam![/b]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes Live-Stream Delayed
